import math
import sys

base = int(sys.argv[1])
vals: list[int | float] = [-base-1, -base, -1, 0, 1, base, base+1, -float(base), float(base), -0.0, 0.5, float("inf"), -float("inf"), float("nan")]
for i in range(len(vals)):
    for j in range(len(vals)):
        a = vals[i]
        b = vals[j]
        pair: list[int | float] = [a,b]
        left: list[int | float] = [a]
        right: list[int | float] = [b]
        print(i,j,left < right,left <= right,left > right,left >= right,repr(min(pair)),repr(max(pair)),repr(sorted(pair)),repr(sorted(pair,reverse=True)))

    print("sum",repr(sum(xs)),repr(sum(xs,0.5)),repr(sum(x for x in xs)),repr(math.fsum(xs)))
    zero: list[int | float] = [0 for x in xs]
